title: Compute particles
description: Particles move and bounce inside a square. The CPU creates their data once, then the GPU handles movement and rendering from the same buffer without a CPU readback in between.
unavailable: WebGPU is not available in this browser.
failed: The particle demo stopped after an error.
shaderHelp: Each frame, the compute shader updates particle positions and reverses their velocity when they reach a boundary. The render pass reads this buffer directly as instance data to draw one disk per particle. The data stays on the GPU between the two passes. The WGSL shown below is the actual compiled code.
